&=&\displaystyle\sum_{m_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453877}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453878}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}}\in[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453877}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453878}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}\left(\sum_{k=1}^{K}\left(\prod_{d=1}^{D}\left(\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1066234}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B}_{d})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1066234}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B}_{d})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{982373}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B}_{d})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2.67682pt}{\resizebox{1077368}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B}_{d})\mathstrut$}}}}}}(\mathbf{v}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{764028}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(k)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{764028}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(k)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{666563}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(k)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{666563}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(k)\mathstrut$}}}}}}_{d})\right)_{m_{d}}\right)\right)\mathbf In fact, one even has that
\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}
is the unique linear function
\mathbb{T}\to\mathbb{R}^{[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453877}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453878}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}
such that

\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\circ\otimes_{\mathbb{T}}=\otimes\circ\left(\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1059046}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B}_{1})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1059046}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B}_{1})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{975038}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B}_{1})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2.29443pt}{\resizebox{1067100}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.05pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B}_{1})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\times\cdots\times\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1183845}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B}_{D})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1183845}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B}_{D})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{1102383}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B}_{D})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2.59186pt}{\resizebox{1245382}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.18611pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B}_{D})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\right)

which is guaranteed to exist by the universal property of the
D
-fold tensor product. Thus everything that can ever be said about
\mathbb{T}
as a
D
-fold tensor space can be explored by choosing basises for each of the
\mathbb{V}_{1}
, …,
\mathbb{V}_{D}
, and subsequently working in the coordinate space
\mathbb{R}^{[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453877}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453878}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}
.

Appendix A.7
Representing Dual Spaces with Coordinates

Given a finite-dimensional real vector space
\mathbb{V}
with
\dim(\mathbb{V})=M
, one has that
\dim(\left(\mathbb{V}\right)^{\ast})=M
(recall that
\left(\mathbb{V}\right)^{\ast}\overset{\text{def}}{=}\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{V};\mathbb{R})
), thus
\mathbb{V}
and
\left(\mathbb{V}\right)^{\ast}
are isomorphic as real vector spaces. The most common choices of isomorphism used to identify them choose a basis
\mathscr{B}=\{\mathbf{b}_{1},\dots,\mathbf{b}_{M}\}
for
\mathbb{V}
and then associate each element
\mathbf{b}_{m}
of
\mathscr{B}
with the corresponding element

Observe also that a choice of isomorphism
\left(\mathbb{V}\right)^{\ast}\overset{\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}}{\underset{(\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}})^{-1}}{\rightleftarrows}}\mathbb{V}
is equivalent to choosing a bilinear function
\mathbb{V}\times\mathbb{V}\to\mathbb{R}
, in the sense that there is a one-to-one correspondence between identifications
\psi
of
\left(\mathbb{V}\right)^{\ast}
with
\mathbb{V}
and bilinear functions
\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\psi}:\mathbb{V}\times\mathbb{V}\to\mathbb{R}
given by

\psi^{-1}:\mathbf{v}\mapsto\langle\mathbf{v},\cdot\rangle_{\psi}

and

\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\psi}:(\mathbf{v}_{1},\mathbf{v}_{2})\mapsto\left(\psi^{-1}(\mathbf{v}_{1})\right)(\mathbf{v}_{2})\,.

This fact is related to the Riesz Representation theorem and the statement that Hilbert spaces are isomorphic to their duals, although discussing this in the detail it deserves would also derail the discussion too far afield. Note at the very least that the identification between
\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{V};\left(V\right)^{\ast})
and
\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{V},\mathbb{V};\mathbb{R})
is not just a bijection, but also a linear isomorphism.

m\in[M]
:

\left(\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\right)^{\ast}:\varphi_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\mapsto\varphi_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}}\,.

For any basis
\mathscr{B}
of any
M
-dimensional real vector space
\mathbb{V}
the following is also true:

\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}}\circ\left(\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\right)^{\ast}=\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\circ\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\,,

and since all functions in question are invertible:

\begin{array}[]{rcl}\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}&=&\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}}\circ\left(\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\right)^{\ast}\circ\left(\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\right)^{-1}\,,\\
\left(\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\right)^{\ast}&=&\left(\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}}\right)^{-1}\circ\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\circ\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\,,\\
\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}}&=&\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\circ\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\circ\left(\left(\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\right)^{\ast}\right)^{-1}\,,\\
\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}&=&\left(\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\right)^{-1}\circ\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}}\circ\left(\Phi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{847815}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{744882}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(\mathscr{B})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\right)^{\ast}\,.\end{array}

Therefore all questions regarding the identification of any
M
-dimensional vector space
\mathbb{V}
with its dual
\left(\mathbb{V}\right)^{\ast}
, using any choice of basis
\mathscr{B}
for
\mathbb{V}
, can always be reduced to the study of the identification of
\mathbb{R}^{M}
with its dual
\left(\mathbb{R}^{M}\right)^{\ast}
using its standard basis. Thus, in what follows the discussion will be restricted exclusively to the identification of
\mathbb{R}^{M}
with
\left(\mathbb{R}^{M}\right)^{\ast}
via the standard basis of
\mathbb{R}^{M}
and its dual basis, with it implicit that the restricted discussion can readily be generalized from coordinate spaces
\mathbb{R}^{M}
with the standard basises to arbitrary finite-dimensional real vector spaces with arbitrary basises via the use of the coordinate isomorphisms and dual coordinate isomorphisms.

Appendix A.8
Representing Linear Functions with Coordinates

Given the standard identification
\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}}:\left(\mathbb{R}^{M}\right)^{\ast}\to\mathbb{R}^{M}
from appendix
A.7
, it is possible not only to identify
\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M};\mathbb{R})=\left(\mathbb{R}^{M}\right)^{\ast}
with
\mathbb{R}^{M}
, it is also possible to identify the space of all linear functions
\mathbb{R}^{M}\to\mathbb{R}^{N}
, denoted
\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M};\mathbb{R}^{N})
, with
\mathbb{R}^{[N]\times[M]}
. Specifically, given a linear function
\mathcal{L}:\mathbb{R}^{M}\to\mathbb{R}^{N}
, one may focus attention onto the values it takes for the standard basis of
\mathbb{R}^{M}
, i.e.
\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}})\in\mathbb{R}^{N}
for all
m\in[M]
. Doing this one then discovers the following for any
\mathbf{v}\in\mathbb{R}^{M}
:

\mathcal{L}:\mathbf{v}\mapsto\sum_{m=1}^{M}\varphi_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}}(\mathbf{v})\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}})=\sum_{m=1}^{M}v_{m}\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}})\,.

One can then show that
\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M};\mathbb{R}^{N})
satisfies the universal property of the tensor product for
\left(\mathbb{R}^{N},\left(\mathbb{R}^{M}\right)^{\ast}\right)
by using the tensor product defined for each
\mathbf{w}\in\mathbb{R}^{N}
,
\phi\in\left(\mathbb{R}^{M}\right)^{\ast}
via the rule:

\bigotimes_{\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M};\mathbb{R}^{N})}:(\mathbf{w},\phi)\mapsto(\mathbf{v}\mapsto\phi(\mathbf{v})\mathbf{w})\,.

Hence one usually chooses to identify
\mathcal{L}\in\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M};\mathbb{R}^{N})
with the following tensor
\mathbf{L}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times M}
:

\mathbf{L}=\sum_{m=1}^{M}\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}})\otimes\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}}(\varphi_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}})=\sum_{m=1}^{M}\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}})\otimes\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\,,

where in the above equation
\otimes
denotes the Segre outer product.

The above identification is a tensor product of linear maps as defined in appendix
A.10.3
:

\operatorname{Id}_{\mathbb{R}^{N}}\otimes\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}}:\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M};\mathbb{R}^{N})=\mathbb{R}^{N}\underset{{\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M};\mathbb{R}^{N})}}{\otimes}\left(\mathbb{R}^{M}\right)^{\ast}\to\mathbb{R}^{N}\otimes\mathbb{R}^{M}=\mathbb{R}^{N\times M}\,,

which is an isomorphism in
\mathsf{Fin}_{\mathbb{R}}\mathsf{Tens}_{2}
as it is the tensor product of two vector space isomorphisms.

\mathbf{L}
is the matrix whose
m
’th column
\mathbf{L}_{:m}
is
\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}})
represented with respect to the standard basis of
\mathbb{R}^{N}
. This leads to the typical

.
definition of matrix multiplication: for any
\mathbf{v}\in\mathbb{R}^{M}
,

\sum_{m=1}^{M}v_{m}\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}})=\sum_{m=1}^{M}v_{m}\mathbf{L}_{:m}=\mathbf{L}\bullet_{2}\mathbf{v}=\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{v})\,.

A.8.1
Linear Functions with Vector Inputs and Tensor Outputs

Clearly one can extend this identification further to linear functions
\mathcal{L}\in\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M};\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]})
, since analogous to the relationship above one has for every
\mathbf{v}\in\mathbb{R}^{M}
that

\mathcal{L}:\mathbf{v}\mapsto\sum_{m=1}^{M}\varphi_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}}(\mathbf{v})\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}})=\sum_{m=1}^{M}v_{m}\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}})\,,

Using
\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}}
one may identify
\mathcal{L}\in\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M};\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]})
with an order
(O+1)
tensor:

\mathbfcal{L}=\sum_{m=1}^{M}\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{894650}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{894650}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{795081}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{795080}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}})\otimes\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{894650}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{894650}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{795081}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{795080}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}}(\varphi_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{894650}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{894650}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{795081}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{795080}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}})=\sum_{m=1}^{M}\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{894650}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{894650}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{795081}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{795080}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}})\otimes\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{894650}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{894650}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{795081}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{795080}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\,,

where as before
\otimes
denotes the Segre outer product in the above expression.
\mathbfcal{L}
is a tensor whose
m
’th hyperslice of shape
[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.36574pt}{\resizebox{553683}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.36574pt}{\resizebox{553683}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.36572pt}{\resizebox{481937}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.36574pt}{\resizebox{481932}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]
(corresponding to the first
O
modes)
\mathbfcal{L}_{:_{[O]}m}
is the value of
\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}})
represented with respect to the standard basis of unit tensors
\mathbfcal{I}_{n_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-0.83333pt}{\resizebox{412396}{163840}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.83333pt}{\resizebox{412396}{163840}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.83333pt}{\resizebox{294060}{163840}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.83333pt}{\resizebox{294061}{163840}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}}
of
\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}
.

Once more analogous to the relationship above, the value of
\mathcal{L}
applied to any vector
\mathbf{v}\in\mathbb{R}^{M}
can be expressed via contraction with the final (in this case
(O+1)
’th) mode of the tensor
\mathbfcal{L}
:

\sum_{m=1}^{{M}}v_{m}\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{e}_{m}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M})\mathstrut$}}}}}})=\sum_{m=1}^{{M}}v_{m}\mathbfcal{L}_{:_{[O]}m}=\mathbfcal{L}\bullet_{O+1}\mathbf{v}=\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{v})\,.

And also again analogous to the above,
\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M};\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]})
satisfies the universal property of the tensor product for the pair of vector spaces
\left(\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]},\left(\mathbb{R}^{M}\right)^{\ast}\right)
, when using the tensor product defined for each
\mathbfcal{U}\in\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-0.83333pt}{\resizebox{412396}{163840}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.83333pt}{\resizebox{412396}{163840}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.83333pt}{\resizebox{294060}{163840}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.83333pt}{\resizebox{294061}{163840}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}
and
\phi\in\left(\mathbb{R}^{M}\right)^{\ast}
via the rule of assignment:

\bigotimes_{\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M};\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]})}:(\mathbfcal{U},\phi)\mapsto(\mathbf{v}\mapsto\phi(\mathbf{v})\mathbfcal{U})\,.

The above identification of
\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M};\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]})
with
\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]\times[M]}
is a tensor product of linear maps:

\operatorname{Id}_{\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}}\otimes\psi^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1047311}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{930752}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{930751}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(M)\mathstrut$}}}}}}:\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M};\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]})=\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}\underset{\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M};\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebo which again is an isomorphism in
\mathsf{Fin}_{\mathbb{R}}\mathsf{Tens}_{2}
as a result of being the tensor product of two vector space isomorphisms as defined in appendix
A.10.3
.

A.8.2
Linear Functions with Tensor Inputs and Tensor Outputs

Moreover, this procedure extends yet further to identify linear functions
\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453877}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453878}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]};\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]})
with tensors in
\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]\times[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453877}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453878}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}
once one establishes a standard way of identifying
\left(\mathbb{R}^{[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453877}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453878}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}\right)^{\ast}
with
\mathbb{R}^{[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453877}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453878}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}
, since
\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453877}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453878}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]};\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]})
satisfies the universal property of the tensor product (and thus is an object of
\mathsf{Fin}_{\mathbb{R}}\mathsf{Tens}_{2}
) for the pair of vector spaces
\left(\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]},\left(\mathbb{R}^{[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453877}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453878}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}\right)^{\ast}\right)
when using the tensor product defined for every
\mathbfcal{U}\in\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-0.83333pt}{\resizebox{412396}{163840}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.83333pt}{\resizebox{412396}{163840}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.83333pt}{\resizebox{294060}{163840}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.83333pt}{\resizebox{294061}{163840}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}
and
\phi\in\left(\mathbb{R}^{[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453877}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453878}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}\right)^{\ast}
via the relationship:

\bigotimes_{\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453877}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453878}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]};\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]})}:(\mathbfcal{U},\phi)\mapsto(\mathbfcal{T}\mapsto\phi(\mathbfcal{T})\mathbfcal{U})\,.

As seen above, tensor contractions amount to applying linear functions between coordinate spaces. For example, using the notation from
[
205
]
, which is usually called Einstein notation, the symbol:

\mathcal{T}^{m_{1}m_{2}}_{m_{3}m_{4}m_{5}}

corresponds to the standard contravariant representation (as defined above) of some linear function
\mathbb{R}^{[M_{3}]\times[M_{4}]\times[M_{5}]}\to\mathbb{R}^{[M_{1}]\times[M_{2}]}
. The contraction written in Einstein notation as

\mathcal{T}^{m_{1}m_{2}}_{m_{3}m_{4}m_{5}}\mathcal{U}^{m_{3}m_{4}m_{5}}

corresponds to the result of applying the aforementioned linear function to some
\mathbfcal{U}\in\mathbb{R}^{[M_{3}]\times[M_{4}]\times[M_{5}]}
. Finally, the contraction written in Einstein notation as:

\mathcal{T}^{m_{1}m_{2}}_{m_{3}m_{4}m_{5}}\mathcal{S}^{m_{3}m_{4}m_{5}}_{m_{6}m_{7}}

corresponds to composing another linear function in
\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{[M_{6}]\times[M_{7}]};\mathbb{R}^{[M_{3}]\times[M_{4}]\times[M_{5}]})
with the aforementioned linear function in
\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{[M_{3}]\times[M_{4}]\times[M_{5}]};\mathbb{R}^{[M_{1}]\times[M_{2}]})
. Of course the above three examples don’t provide a direct interpretation for all possible types of contractions which can be written using Einstein notation, e.g. the very existence of the notion of tensor network implies the existence of far more complicated patterns, but it is a start.

Observe that, analogous to previous examples, the above identification of
\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453877}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453878}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]};\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]})
with
\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]\times[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{627204}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453877}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{453878}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[D]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}
corresponds to the tensor product of linear maps:

Comparing the above two outer product representations, it is clear that, although
\mathbfcal{L}\not=\mathbfcal{L}_{1}\otimes\mathbfcal{L}_{2}
, all of the information necessary to compute
\mathbfcal{L}
is still present in
\mathbfcal{L}_{1}
and
\mathbfcal{L}_{2}
. There exists a well-defined bilinear function which, given
\mathbfcal{L}_{1}
and
\mathbfcal{L}_{2}
, will return the corresponding
\mathbfcal{L}

Although the contiguous partitions of the modes of
\mathbfcal{T}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{626111}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle(1)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{626111}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle(1)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{547102}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle(1)\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63332pt}{\resizebox{547102}{321125}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle(1)\mathstrut$}}}}}}
and

have been suppressed from the notation for the Zehfuss product given in the above equations, the contiguous partitions
must
be specified somehow before the Zehfuss product can be well-defined.

In the case that both tensors are the standard contravariant representation of linear functions between coordinate spaces, as in the examples above, the contiguous partitions of the modes into two blocks can be considered implicitly specified by the requirements that (i) the first block of modes corresponds to the function’s codomain and (ii) the second block of modes corresponds to the function’s domain. Yet even in that case it is necessary to make explicit
which
linear function between coordinate spaces the tensor is intended to represent.

For example, already for an order-
2
tensor (matrix)
\mathbf{L}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W}
can be considered, in an equally valid manner

In general, an order
O
tensor can be interpreted, in an equally valid manner, as the contravariant representation of
(O+1)
distinct linear functions, even after having chosen a single “standard” way of identifying linear functions with any domain or codomain as tensors. Thus simply stating that two tensors represent linear functions is by itself insufficient to implicitly specify the contiguous partitions of modes needed to make the Zehfuss product well-defined; the domains and codomains of those linear functions must also be specified.

The definition of Zehfuss product can be extended to more than
2
tensors (each with a specified contiguous partitions of its modes) in a straightforward way. The most common example in the practice is the case of
O
order
2
tensors, each being the contravariant representation
\mathbf{L}_{o}
of a linear function in
\mathcal{L}_{o}\in\mathcal{L}(\mathbb{R}^{M_{o}};\mathbb{R}^{N_{o}})
. Then the
O
-fold Zehfuss product of these tensors is the order
2O
tensor given by the outer product decomposition:

\begin{array}[]{rcl}\displaystyle\bigotimes_{Z}(\mathbf{L}_{1},\dots,\mathbf{L}_{O})&=&\displaystyle\sum_{m_{1}=1}^{{M_{1}}}\cdots\sum_{m_{O}=1}^{{M_{O}}}\mathcal{L}_{1}(\mathbf{e}_{m_{1}}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1258542}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1258542}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{1160909}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2.29443pt}{\resizebox{1252969}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.05pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}})\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathcal{L}_{o}(\mathbf{e}_{m_{O}}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1360485}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1360485}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{1264931}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2.59186pt}{\resizebox{1398600}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.18611pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}})\otimes\mathbf{e}_{m_{1}}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1258542}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1258542}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{1160909}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2.29443pt}{\resizebox{1252969}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.05pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathbf{e}_{m_{O}}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1360485}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1360485}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{1264931}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2.59186pt}{\resizebox{1398600}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.18611pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\\
&=&\vskip 3.0pt plus 1.0pt minus 1.0pt\displaystyle\sum_{m_{1}=1}^{{M_{1}}}\cdots\sum_{m_{O}=1}^{{M_{O}}}(\mathbf{L}_{1})_{:m_{1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes(\mathbf{L}_{O})_{:m_{O}}\otimes\mathbf{e}_{m_{1}}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1258542}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1258542}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{1160909}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2.29443pt}{\resizebox{1252969}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.05pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathbf{e}_{m_{O}}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1360485}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1360485}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{1264931}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2.59186pt}{\resizebox{1398600}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.18611pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\,,\end{array}

since this is the (standard) contravariant representation of the linear transformation
\mathcal{L}\overset{\text{def}}{=}\bigotimes_{o=1}^{O}\mathcal{L}_{o}
.

Defining
[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.36574pt}{\resizebox{553683}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.36574pt}{\resizebox{553683}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.36572pt}{\resizebox{481937}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.36574pt}{\resizebox{481932}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]=\bigtimes_{o=1}^{O}[M_{o}]
, the lexicographical matricization of the above Zehfuss product
\bigotimes_{Z}(\mathbf{L}_{1},\dots,\mathbf{L}_{O})
representing the linear function
\mathcal{L}\overset{\text{def}}{=}\bigotimes_{o=1}^{O}\mathcal{L}_{o}
is the matrix:

\begin{array}[]{cl}&\displaystyle\sum_{m_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}\in[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}\operatorname{vec}_{\operatorname{lex}}(\mathcal{L}_{1}(\mathbf{e}_{m_{1}}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1258542}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1258542}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{1160909}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2.29443pt}{\resizebox{1252969}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.05pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}})\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathcal{L}_{o}(\mathbf{e}_{m_{O}}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1360485}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1360485}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{1264931}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2.59186pt}{\resizebox{1398600}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.18611pt}{$\scri =&\vskip 3.0pt plus 1.0pt minus 1.0pt\displaystyle\sum_{m_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}\in[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}\operatorname{vec}_{\operatorname{lex}}((\mathbf{L}_{1})_{:m_{1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes(\mathbf{L}_{O})_{:m_{O}})\otimes\operatorname{vec}_{\operatorname{lex}}(\mathbf{e}_{m_{1}}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1258542}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1258542}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{1160909}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2.29443pt}{\resizebox{1252969}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.05pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}}\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathbf{e}_{m_{O}}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1360485}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1360485}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{1264931}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2. =&\vskip 3.0pt plus 1.0pt minus 1.0pt\mathbf{L}_{1}\otimes_{\operatorname{Kr}}\mathbf{L}_{2}\otimes_{\operatorname{Kr}}\cdots\otimes_{\operatorname{Kr}}\mathbf{L}_{O}\,,\end{array}

and the colexicographical matricization is the matrix:

\begin{array}[]{cl}&\displaystyle\sum_{m_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}\in[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{607147}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432927}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{432929}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}\operatorname{vec}_{\operatorname{col}}(\mathcal{L}_{1}(\mathbf{e}_{m_{1}}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1258542}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1258542}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{1160909}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2.29443pt}{\resizebox{1252969}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.05pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle({M_{1}})\mathstrut$}}}}}})\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathcal{L}_{o}(\mathbf{e}_{m_{O}}^{\scriptsize\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1360485}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91203pt}{\resizebox{1360485}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.91202pt}{\resizebox{1264931}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle({M_{O}})\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-2.59186pt}{\resizebox{1398600}{375921}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.18611pt}{$\scri
