the
direct
sum
of
the
vector
spaces

\mathbb{R}^{s}

for
every
element

s\in S

for
an
arbitrary
set

S
.
This
would
seem
to
not
open
yet
another
can
of
worms
since
the
direct
sum
refers
to
a
specific
construction,
although
that
construction
is
of
interest
primarily
because
it
satisfies
the
universal
property
of
the
coproduct.

f.

In
the
case
that
any
of

[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.36574pt}{\resizebox{704563}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle[O_{1}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.36574pt}{\resizebox{704563}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle[O_{1}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.36572pt}{\resizebox{646335}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle[O_{1}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63889pt}{\resizebox{712089}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.05pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O_{1}]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]

or

[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.36574pt}{\resizebox{704563}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle[O_{2}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.36574pt}{\resizebox{704563}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle[O_{2}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.36572pt}{\resizebox{646335}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle[O_{2}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.63889pt}{\resizebox{712089}{268516}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.05pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O_{2}]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]

are
“proper
multi-index

i.e.
of
order

2

or
greater,
then
one
has
to
apply
the
SVD
to
the
linear
function

\mathcal{L}_{\operatorname{vec}}:\mathbb{R}^{\mathbf{M}}\to\mathbb{R}^{\mathbf{N}}
,
where

\mathbf{M}\overset{\text{def}}{=}\prod_{o_{1}=1}^{O_{1}}M_{o_{1}}
,

\mathbf{N}\overset{\text{def}}{=}\prod_{o_{2}=1}^{O_{2}}N_{o_{2}}
,
and

\mathcal{L}_{\operatorname{vec}}=\operatorname{vec}_{N}\circ\mathcal{L}\circ\operatorname{vec}_{M}^{-1}\,,\quad\mathcal{L}=\operatorname{vec}_{N}^{-1}\circ\mathcal{L}_{\operatorname{vec}}\circ\operatorname{vec}_{M}\,,

with

\operatorname{vec}_{M}

and

\operatorname{vec}_{N}

any
arbitrary
isomorphisms

\mathbb{R}^{[M_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{751874}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O_{1}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{751874}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O_{1}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{593735}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O_{1}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4722pt}{\resizebox{658060}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.74998pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O_{1}]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}\to\mathbb{R}^{\mathbf{M}}

and

\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{751874}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O_{2}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{751874}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O_{2}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{593735}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O_{2}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4722pt}{\resizebox{658060}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.74998pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O_{2}]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}\to\mathbb{R}^{\mathbf{N}}

respectively.

From
the
left
singular
vectors

\mathbf{u}

of

\mathcal{L}_{\operatorname{vec}}

one
then
gets
“left
singular
tensors”

\mathbfcal{U}

via

\mathbfcal{U}=\operatorname{vec}_{N}^{-1}(\mathbf{u})
,
and
from
the
right
singular
vectors

\mathbf{v}

of

\mathcal{L}_{\operatorname{vec}}

one
gets
“right
singular
tensors”

\mathbfcal{V}

via

\mathbfcal{V}=\operatorname{vec}_{M}^{-1}(\mathbf{v})
.
Then
one
has

\mathcal{L}(\mathbfcal{U})=\sigma\mathbfcal{V}

for
every
pair
of
“singular
tensors”
and
their
corresponding
singular

to

\mathcal{L}

as

preceded

Of

\mathbb{R}^{[N_{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{751874}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle[O_{2}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{751874}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle[O_{2}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.22687pt}{\resizebox{593735}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle[O_{2}]\mathstrut$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4722pt}{\resizebox{658060}{241212}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.74998pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle[O_{2}]\mathstrut$}}}}}}]}
